high_level_description: The image shows two individuals taking a selfie outdoors during what appears to be late afternoon or early evening, as indicated by the warm lighting and long shadows. The person on the left has long dark hair and is smiling broadly, showing their teeth. They are wearing a light-colored top with a patterned design. The person on the right has short, spiky hair and a beard, and they are also smiling, though not as widely as the other individual. They are dressed in a dark-colored shirt with a lighter inner collar.
